slots.image_prompt: A futuristic tech-inspired cover composition on a deep navy background (#1E293B). Interlocking metallic gears in brushed steel and copper tones float across the frame, their teeth catching subtle sky blue (#2196F3) rim lighting. Strands of luminous cyan code lines (#00BCD4) weave through the gears like digital threads, dissolving into particle effects at the edges. Volumetric fog drifts in the background with a soft blue glow emanating from behind the central mechanical elements. Cinematic depth of field, ultra-detailed, atmospheric haze, octane render quality, editorial-grade composition.

An abstract dark tech background featuring flowing vertical streams of glowing cyan (#00BCD4) and sky blue (#2196F3) code characters, rendered as semi-transparent vertical data ribbons cascading down a deep slate (#1E293B) canvas. Faint geometric wireframe grids overlay the background at low opacity, creating depth layers. Subtle light streaks and bokeh particles drift diagonally across the composition. The mood is calm yet dynamic, with a clean editorial feel and generous negative space on the right for text overlay. Digital art, minimalist tech aesthetic, high contrast.

A symbolic composition merging craftsmanship with technology, set on a deep navy (#1E293B) background. Surrounding the gear, delicate handwritten formula marks and architectural blueprints dissolve into digital particle streams in cyan (#00BCD4). Soft warm amber light accents contrast with the cool blue, symbolizing human warmth meeting cold engineering. Ethereal, philosophical atmosphere, painterly digital art style, 4k detail.

The overall composition feels expansive and interconnected, with ample negative space on the left side for section title overlay. Digital art, minimalist network aesthetic.

Each ray represents a connection, thin and elegant, gradually brightening as they approach the convergence point which emits a soft halo of warm-white and blue light.
